== 🎯 Goal and target group ==
Why does this event take place, and who should attend? Name a measurable goal – it makes the review at the end much easier.

*'''Goal:''' e.g. 80 registrations, 50 participants on site
*'''Target group:''' who do we invite?
*'''Format:''' on site / hybrid / online

{{Textbox|boxtype=tip|header=Working with this checklist|text=Tick a task as soon as it is started or finished. Delete rows you do not need and add your own – the tables are sortable by every column.|icon=yes}}
